scientific_limitations: Complete only for possible Lie-algebra dimensions of five-dimensional real Banach spaces; does not classify norms, isometry groups, or other dimensions. The proof invokes standard compact Lie algebra structure and Rosenthal’s 1986 theorem.
title: The possible skew-isometry Lie dimensions of real five-dimensional Banach spaces
